Package org.openxava.chat.impl

Class EntityTools

java.lang.Object
org.openxava.chat.impl.BaseEntityTools
org.openxava.chat.impl.EntityTools
public class EntityTools extends BaseEntityTools
Generic tools for accessing OpenXava entity data using LangChain4j. Works with any entity in any OpenXava application.
Since:
7.7
Author:
Javier Paniza

  • Method Details

    • getAvailableEntities

      public Collection<String> getAvailableEntities()
      Returns the list of available entities in the application. Only returns modules that the current user has permission to access.
      Returns:
      A list of entity names the user can access

    • getEntityProperties

      public List<String> getEntityProperties(String entity)
      Returns the list of available properties for an entity. Use this to know which properties can be used in conditions.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      Returns:
      A list of property names available for the entity

    • getEntityCollections

      public Map<String,List<String>> getEntityCollections(String entity)
      Returns the list of collections for an entity with their properties. Use this to know which collections an entity has and what properties each collection contains. Collections cannot be used in conditions, only to understand the entity structure.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      Returns:
      A map where keys are collection names and values are lists of property names in each collection

    • getEntityCount

      public long getEntityCount(String entity)
      Returns the total number of records in an entity.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      Returns:
      The count of records in the entity

    • findFirst600Entities

      public List<Map<String,Object>> findFirst600Entities(String entity)
      Returns the first 600 records from an entity.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      Returns:
      A list with up to 600 records

    • findEntitiesByCondition

      public List<Map<String,Object>> findEntitiesByCondition(String entity, String condition)
      Returns records from an entity that match a SQL-style condition. The condition uses property names wrapped in ${}, e.g., "${name} = 'John'" or "${price} > 100".
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      condition - SQL-style condition with property names in ${}, e.g., "${status} = 'active' AND ${amount} > 1000"
      Returns:
      A list of records matching the condition (up to 600)

    • getEntityDetails

      public Map<String,Object> getEntityDetails(String entity, Map<String,Object> key)
      Returns the details of an entity given its key. The key can be obtained from the hiddenKey field returned by findEntities methods.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      key - The entity key as a Map (obtained from hiddenKey)
      Returns:
      A map with all the entity details

    • consumePendingFilterValues

      public Map<String,String> consumePendingFilterValues()
      Returns the pending filter values and clears them. The keys are in the format "conditionValue___N" for JavaScript.

    • filterList

      public String filterList(String entity, Map<String,String> values, Map<String,String> comparators)
      Filters the list of the current module by setting condition values for the filterable properties.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name the user is asking about
      values - Map of property names to filter values
      comparators - Map of property names to comparators (optional)
      Returns:
      A confirmation message or error description

    • getCurrentModule

      public String getCurrentModule()
      Returns information about the entity currently being displayed in detail mode. This allows the LLM to know which record the user is viewing/editing, so the user can say things like "change the address of the current record".
      Returns:
      A map with "entity" (module name) and "key" (the entity key), or null if not in detail mode
